data.name: Aribah
data.gender_notes: Aribah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'araba' which means 'to elevate' or 'to exalt'. The name Aribah is given to a girl symbolizing nobility, exaltedness, and high status. The name Aribah carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aribah usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A guide for those lost in spiritual darkness, helping them find their way back to the light
data.etymology: Aribah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aribah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_urdu.name: عریبہ
